Reword the question so that it asks exactly the same thing in different words and a different sentence
structure. Keep every name, model, position number, article number, date and condition exactly. Do not add or
remove any detail. Return only the reworded question.

The verifications of the IGEA devices are entrusted to an authorised body: under the Ministerial Decree of 11 April 2011, for how long at least must the authorised body keep the documents relating to the verification activity?

response.text: Under the Ministerial Decree of 11 April 2011, when the IGEA devices' verifications are entrusted to an authorised body, what is the minimum length of time that body must retain the documentation concerning its verification activity?
